description: This PHP source file defines a subpanel view for the Email Marketing module in SuiteCRM. It generates an HTML form with buttons to create new email marketing entries, sets up a ListView object with a specific template, and assigns images and URLs for inline editing and removal within the subpanel interface.

classes.name: ListView
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering list views within the SuiteCRM interface, initializing templates, assigning images, and processing data for display.

methods.name: initNewXTemplate
methods.description: Initializes the ListView with a specified HTML template and language strings.

methods.name: xTemplateAssign
methods.description: Assigns variables or images to the XTemplate used in the ListView for rendering.

methods.name: setHeaderTitle
methods.description: Sets the header title for the list view.

methods.name: setHeaderText
methods.description: Sets the header text, often including buttons or links, for the list view.

methods.name: processListView
methods.description: Processes and renders the list view with the provided data, which in this case is focus_list.
